name: avery-labels
description: Print address labels, name badges and place cards from a list or spreadsheet, lined up with standard label sheets.
keywords: print labels from excel without word

interface.longDescription:
Print address labels from a list or a spreadsheet without opening Word. Paste names and addresses, or attach a CSV or Excel file, and get a print-ready PDF that lines up with standard US Letter label sheets, such as the 5160 size (30 per sheet, 1 x 2-5/8 in) and its equivalents 8160, 5260 and 18160.

What you can make:
- Mailing and address labels for Christmas cards, wedding invitations and newsletters (5160, 5161, 5162)
- Return address labels: one address repeated to fill a sheet (5167, 80 per sheet; 5195, 60 per sheet)
- Shipping labels for Etsy or Shopify orders on sheet labels (5163, 5164, 5168, 5126 half sheets)
- Name badges and name tags (5395, 5390 inserts, 22805 square labels)
- Place cards that fold in half, with the name readable from both sides (5302 tent cards)
- File folder labels (5366)

How it works: name, street, apartment, city, state and ZIP columns are found from the headings, including Google Contacts, Outlook, Etsy and Shopify exports, or you can say which column is which. US addresses are formatted the USPS way (City, ST 12345), state names become two-letter codes, and ZIP codes that lost their leading zero in Excel (2134 becomes 02134) are fixed. Long names and addresses shrink to fit the label. Start on any label of a partly used sheet (for example label 7), print copies of each label, sort by ZIP or name, add outlines, or print an alignment test page first. Letters with accents, Polish, Greek and Cyrillic names print correctly.

The preview in the chat shows the first sheet with each label in place, a sheet picker and a starts-at-label control. You also get a cleaned address list as CSV with problems per row (missing ZIP, unknown state, duplicates).

Limitations: US Letter sheets only; addresses are formatted but not verified against USPS data; no postage, barcodes or label printers; up to 10,000 rows per file and 15,000 labels per PDF; Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew and emoji characters are left out of the PDF. Avery is a trademark of its owner; Sheetwise Label Maker is not affiliated with it and only prints to the same sheet sizes.
defaultPrompt: Make 5160 address labels: Jane Smith, 123 Main St Apt 4B, Springfield IL 62704; Raj Patel, 9 Elm Rd, Austin TX 78701
Fill a sheet of 5167 return address labels with The Garcia Family, 42 Oak Lane, Portland, OR 97205
Print name badges on 5395 for Ana Lopez, Engineer at Acme, and Tom Reed, Designer at Brightside

positive.description: Address labels on a 30-per-sheet sheet from a typed list
positive.prompt: Make Avery 5160 address labels for Jane Smith, 123 Main St Apt 4B, Springfield IL 62704; Raj Patel, 9 Elm Rd, Austin TX 78701; and The Garcia Family, 42 Oak Lane, Portland OR 97205
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_label_sheet with template 5160 and the three addresses in labels. Returns 3 labels on 1 sheet of 5160 (30 per sheet, 3 across x 10 down). The first label reads Jane Smith / 123 Main St Apt 4B / Springfield, IL 62704. The reply says the last sheet ends at label 3 and gives a PDF link and a cleaned CSV link; the widget previews the sheet.

positive.description: Return address labels filling a whole sheet
positive.prompt: Make a full sheet of 5167 return address labels for The Garcia Family, 42 Oak Lane, Portland, OR 97205
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_label_sheet with kind return_address, template 5167 and one label. The label is repeated to fill the sheet: 80 labels on 1 sheet (80 per sheet, 4 across x 20 down), each reading The Garcia Family / 42 Oak Lane / Portland, OR 97205, with a PDF link.

positive.description: Starting part-way down a used sheet
positive.prompt: I already used the first 6 labels on my 5160 sheet. Start at label 7: Maria Lopez, 88 Pine St, Denver, CO 80202 and Sam Price, 4 Ocean Dr, Miami Beach, FL 33139
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_label_sheet with template 5160, start_at 7 and the two addresses. The PDF leaves labels 1 to 6 blank and prints Maria Lopez in label 7 and Sam Price in label 8; the reply says to start at 9 next time.

positive.description: Check a mailing list before printing
positive.prompt: Check this mailing list before I print labels: Jane Smith, 123 Main St, Springfield, Illinois 62704; Tom Reed, 500 Pine Ave, Seattle WA; Raj Patel, 9 Elm Rd, Austin, TX 78701
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_mailing_list with the three addresses in labels. Reports 3 records: 2 ready to print and 1 with problems (row 2: no ZIP code for Tom Reed). Illinois is converted to IL, so the first label's last line is Springfield, IL 62704. Returns a cleaned CSV link and suggests fixing the missing ZIP before printing.

positive.description: Look up the measurements of a label sheet
positive.prompt: What size are 5160 labels, and what are the sheet margins?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_label_template with query 5160. Returns 1 match: 5160 address labels, 1 x 2-5/8 in, 3 across x 10 down = 30 per sheet, top margin 1/2 in, side margins 3/16 in, horizontal pitch 2-3/4 in, vertical pitch 1 in, with the same layout as 8160, 5260 and 18160.

negative.prompt: Buy USPS postage and print a shipping label for my 2 lb package to Chicago
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any tool: the plugin prints address text on sheet labels and does not buy postage or make carrier shipping labels.

negative.prompt: Which label maker machine should I buy for organizing my pantry?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any tool: this is a product recommendation for label printer hardware, not a label sheet PDF.

negative.prompt: Make a nutrition facts label for my granola recipe
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any tool: nutrition labels are not address or name labels.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: address, return address, shipping, name badge, place card and file folder labels from a typed list or a CSV/Excel file, as PDFs that line up with 14 standard US Letter label sheet layouts (5160 family and more), with USPS address formatting, shrink-to-fit text, start position, copies, alignment test page, sheet lookup and a mailing list checker.

pl-PL.subtitle: Etykiety adresowe z listy
pl-PL.description:
Drukuj etykiety adresowe z listy lub arkusza bez otwierania Worda. Wklej nazwiska i adresy albo dołącz plik CSV lub Excel, a otrzymasz gotowy do druku PDF dopasowany do standardowych arkuszy etykiet w formacie US Letter, np. rozmiaru 5160 (30 na arkuszu, 1 x 2-5/8 cala).

Etykiety adresowe, zwrotne (jeden adres na cały arkusz), wysyłkowe, identyfikatory imienne, winietki składane na stół i etykiety na teczki. Kolumny imienia, ulicy, miasta, stanu i kodu ZIP są wykrywane z nagłówków (Google Contacts, Outlook, Etsy, Shopify). Adresy w USA są formatowane według zasad USPS, długie wiersze zmniejszają się, by się zmieścić, a druk można zacząć od dowolnej etykiety częściowo użytego arkusza. Polskie znaki drukują się poprawnie.

Ograniczenia: tylko arkusze US Letter; adresy nie są weryfikowane w bazie USPS; brak opłat pocztowych i kodów kreskowych. Avery jest znakiem towarowym swojego właściciela; narzędzie nie jest z nim powiązane.

de-DE.subtitle: Adressetiketten aus Listen
de-DE.description:
Drucken Sie Adressetiketten aus einer Liste oder Tabelle, ohne Word zu öffnen. Fügen Sie Namen und Adressen ein oder hängen Sie eine CSV- oder Excel-Datei an und erhalten Sie ein druckfertiges PDF, das genau auf Standard-Etikettenbögen im US-Letter-Format passt, etwa die Größe 5160 (30 pro Bogen, 1 x 2-5/8 Zoll).

Adressetiketten, Absenderetiketten (eine Adresse füllt den ganzen Bogen), Versandetiketten, Namensschilder, faltbare Tischkarten und Ordneretiketten. Spalten für Name, Straße, Ort, Bundesstaat und ZIP werden aus den Überschriften erkannt (Google Contacts, Outlook, Etsy, Shopify). US-Adressen werden nach USPS-Regeln formatiert, lange Zeilen werden verkleinert, und der Druck kann bei jedem Etikett eines angebrochenen Bogens beginnen. Umlaute drucken korrekt.

Einschränkungen: nur US-Letter-Bögen; Adressen werden nicht mit USPS-Daten geprüft; kein Porto, keine Barcodes. Avery ist eine Marke ihres Inhabers; dieses Tool ist nicht damit verbunden.

es-ES.subtitle: Etiquetas de dirección
es-ES.description:
Imprime etiquetas de dirección desde una lista o una hoja de cálculo sin abrir Word. Pega nombres y direcciones o adjunta un archivo CSV o Excel y obtén un PDF listo para imprimir que coincide con las hojas de etiquetas estándar US Letter, como el tamaño 5160 (30 por hoja, 1 x 2-5/8 pulgadas).

Etiquetas de dirección, de remitente (una dirección que llena la hoja), de envío, gafetes con nombre, tarjetas de mesa plegables y etiquetas para carpetas. Las columnas de nombre, calle, ciudad, estado y código ZIP se detectan por los encabezados (Google Contacts, Outlook, Etsy, Shopify). Las direcciones de EE. UU. siguen el formato USPS, las líneas largas se reducen para caber y puedes empezar en cualquier etiqueta de una hoja ya usada. Los acentos se imprimen bien.

Limitaciones: solo hojas US Letter; las direcciones no se verifican con datos de USPS; sin franqueo ni códigos de barras. Avery es una marca de su titular; esta herramienta no está afiliada.

fr-FR.subtitle: Étiquettes d'adresse
fr-FR.description:
Imprimez des étiquettes d'adresse depuis une liste ou un tableur sans ouvrir Word. Collez des noms et adresses ou joignez un fichier CSV ou Excel, et obtenez un PDF prêt à imprimer aligné sur les planches d'étiquettes standard au format US Letter, comme la taille 5160 (30 par planche, 1 x 2-5/8 po).

Étiquettes d'adresse, d'expéditeur (une adresse répétée sur toute la planche), d'expédition, badges nominatifs, marque-places pliables et étiquettes de dossiers. Les colonnes nom, rue, ville, État et code ZIP sont détectées d'après les en-têtes (Google Contacts, Outlook, Etsy, Shopify). Les adresses américaines suivent le format USPS, les lignes longues sont réduites pour tenir, et l'impression peut commencer à n'importe quelle étiquette d'une planche entamée. Les accents s'impriment correctement.

Limites : planches US Letter uniquement ; adresses non vérifiées auprès de l'USPS ; ni affranchissement ni code-barres. Avery est une marque de son propriétaire ; cet outil n'y est pas affilié.

ja-JP.subtitle: リストから宛名ラベル作成
ja-JP.description:
Wordを開かずに、リストやスプレッドシートから宛名ラベルを印刷できます。名前と住所を貼り付けるか、CSVまたはExcelファイルを添付すると、米国レターサイズの標準ラベルシート（例: 5160サイズ、1シート30面、1 x 2-5/8インチ）にぴったり合う印刷用PDFが作成されます。

宛名ラベル、差出人ラベル（1つの住所でシートを埋める）、配送ラベル、名札、折りたたみ式の席札、フォルダーラベルに対応します。氏名・番地・市・州・ZIPの列は見出しから自動検出されます（Google Contacts、Outlook、Etsy、Shopify）。米国の住所はUSPS形式で整形され、長い行は収まるよう縮小され、使いかけのシートの任意の位置から印刷を始められます。

制限: 米国レターサイズのみ。住所はUSPSデータで検証されません。切手やバーコードは作成しません。漢字・かななどのCJK文字はPDFに印刷されません。Averyは各権利者の商標であり、本ツールとは無関係です。

pt-BR.subtitle: Etiquetas de endereço
pt-BR.description:
Imprima etiquetas de endereço a partir de uma lista ou planilha sem abrir o Word. Cole nomes e endereços ou anexe um arquivo CSV ou Excel e receba um PDF pronto para impressão alinhado às folhas de etiquetas padrão US Letter, como o tamanho 5160 (30 por folha, 1 x 2-5/8 pol.).

Etiquetas de endereço, de remetente (um endereço preenchendo a folha), de envio, crachás com nome, marcadores de lugar dobráveis e etiquetas para pastas. As colunas de nome, rua, cidade, estado e ZIP são detectadas pelos cabeçalhos (Google Contacts, Outlook, Etsy, Shopify). Endereços dos EUA seguem o padrão USPS, linhas longas diminuem para caber e a impressão pode começar em qualquer etiqueta de uma folha já usada. Acentos são impressos corretamente.

Limitações: somente folhas US Letter; endereços não são verificados nos dados do USPS; sem postagem nem códigos de barras. Avery é marca de seu titular; esta ferramenta não é afiliada.
